# TerraGuard

> Open-source Terraform checker. A deterministic Go engine finds misconfigurations, apply-time failures and destructive plan changes, fixes many of them, and runs in the browser (WebAssembly), CLI, GitHub Action, VS Code, an MCP server and a self-hosted server. AI is optional and only proposes; the engine verifies. Free, MIT licensed, a learning project.

## Key ideas

- Will-it-apply verdict: predicts terraform validate and apply failures without init or credentials.
- Verified AI fixes: an AI-proposed change is kept only if the engine confirms risk went down and nothing new appeared.
- Diff-aware review: gates only on findings a pull request introduces.
- Policy-as-code: .terraguard.yml with extends, custom rules, expiring waivers, budgets and baselines.
- Pulse: control adoption and waiver inventory across many modules.
- Privacy: code stays on the device in the browser; air-gapped installs make no outside requests.
